findings.message: The function kvm_hv_xsaves_xsavec_maybe_warn acquires a mutex (hv->hv_lock) in the set_efer path. Since set_efer is called during MSR emulation within the VMEXIT handling flow, this occurs in an atomic context. Acquiring a mutex in an atomic context is a violation of kernel constraints and will lead to a 'scheduling while atomic' error or a system crash.
findings.evidence: set_efer in arch/x86/kvm/x86.c calls kvm_hv_xsaves_xsavec_maybe_warn(vcpu), which in turn calls mutex_lock(&hv->hv_lock) in arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c. The call chain from svm_set_efer (arch/x86/kvm/svm.c) or vmx_set_efer (arch/x86/kvm/vmx.c) traces back to the VMEXIT handler, which is a non-sleepable atomic context.

suse_upstream_verification.upstream_subject: KVM: x86: Give a hint when Win2016 might fail to boot due to XSAVES erratum
